report.summary: Patient P-D012 (age 47, Medicaid with transport benefit) is sheltered-homeless with T2DM and diabetic polyneuropathy; insulin glargine requires refrigeration. Screens positive for a transportation barrier and had a recent podiatry no-show. Medication copays are already minimal ($2 insulin, $1 gabapentin, no refill gaps), so med-cost need is low but a backup fund is available. For transport, the patient is NOT age-eligible for the senior shuttle (60+); Medicaid Ride Line is the best fit given the active transport benefit. Paratransit requires ADA certification (up to 21 days). Transit check could not be completed because no facility location is on file for the upcoming 2026-10-22 primary-care visit.
